jobInfo.address: 上海浦东新区圣戈班石膏建材(上海)有限公司968号
jobInfo.postDescription:
Job Purpose: 
To provide project services & support activities, as 1st level of ERP,BPM,Qlik and all new development application services for all Gyproc and Weber operating companies in China follow Agile Service strategy, to coordinate China infrastructure activities for all Gypsum and Weber operation companies in China.
Responsibility:
1.	Perform local IT services/supporting role for delivering the services aligned with services level agreement
2.	Ensure the appropriation of ERP system best practices through appropriate user coordination and training
3.	Support local IT project as initiated by local requirements
4.	Control the preparation of system test and evaluate their outcome to ensure that standard in maintained with quality and usability
5.	Perform user requisition collection, analysis and provider solution and corresponding modification description
6.	Perform sub-project manager role of partially local project
 Qualifications:
1.	1-2 years of experience in M3 or others ERP application experiences of ERP system implementation, business analysis, process design and implementation
2.	Experience in project implementation & manufacturing industry and process is an advantage 
3.	Finance module background is an advantage
